{
"literal": "استعد للجسم الشاطئي هذا الصيف.",
"adaptation": "شكل صحي وصُمَم هذا الصيف قبل الشاطئ المصري الأيقوني.",
"back_translation": "Healthy shape and toned before iconic Egyptian summer beach.",
"approach": "adapted",
"notes": "The original focus on 'beach-body' was changed to 'summer beach' in Egypt to better fit the local culture. The Arabic summer beach generally evokes trips to the Red Sea or Nile beach resorts, which are more culturally significant and attractive than generic 'beach' in some cultures."
}
adaptation: شكل صحي وصُمَم هذا الصيف قبل الشاطئ المصري الأيقوني.
back_translation: Healthy shape and toned before iconic Egyptian summer beach.
notes: The original focus on 'beach-body' was changed to 'summer beach' in Egypt to better fit the local culture. The Arabic summer beach generally evokes trips to the Red Sea or Nile beach resorts, which are more culturally significant and attractive than generic 'beach' in some cultures.
